EditTextPreference.app:title: Messages to load in the list
EditTextPreference.app:summary: How many recent messages the main list scans before grouping into senders (default 1000)

EditTextPreference.app:title: Messages to load per sender
EditTextPreference.app:summary: How many of the newest messages open when you tap a sender (default 100)

EditTextPreference.app:title: Category suffix letters
EditTextPreference.app:summary: Trailing letters treated as sender category suffixes, e.g. G (govt) S (service) P (promo) T (txn)

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Strip glued suffix
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Also strip a trailing category letter when there is no hyphen (best-effort; may over-strip names ending in those letters)

Preference.app:title: Normalize stored sender IDs
Preference.app:summary: Rewrite existing messages' sender to the grouped form (e.g. AX-INDPOST-S → INDPOST). Affects the phone's SMS database; can't be undone.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Notify by default
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: When off, all senders are muted unless whitelisted or a keyword rule forces a notification

Preference.app:title: Keyword rules
Preference.app:summary: Per-sender rules to force-notify or mute messages on keyword match

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Forward messages to server
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: POST received messages to the sms_web_api server so you can read them on the web

Preference.app:title: Sync now
Preference.app:summary: Flush any queued messages to the server immediately

Preference.app:title: Sign in
Preference.app:summary: Log in with Keycloak; the app then refreshes tokens automatically

EditTextPreference.app:title: Account username (optional override)
EditTextPreference.app:summary: Defaults to your signed-in username; set only to store under a different account

EditTextPreference.app:title: Manual bearer token (fallback)
EditTextPreference.app:summary: Only used when not signed in. Paste a Keycloak access token (expires ~hourly)
